name: stats-15
title: Stats with Value Breakdown
description: A stats with value breakdown block.

standards.purpose: Summarize the few numbers that tell someone how things are going.
useWhen: A dashboard opens with a small set of decision-relevant metrics.
doNotUseWhen: The numbers are the page's main content and need their own charts or table.

rules.check: Every metric states its unit and time window; deltas name the comparison period.
Numbers presented as live come from real data; placeholders are labeled.
At most one metric is visually emphasized.
